statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial rate control therapy.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered.
